policy.scope: This file records the current official project and character facts. Localized pages may translate the prose but must preserve these identities and facts.
policy.nonCanon: Song-specific stories, satire, jokes, fan works, and derivative works are not automatically part of the official character canon.
policy.changes: Change the version and updatedAt date when an official fact changes.

sovia.name: Sovia Rabocheva
sovia.description: Fictional interdimensional broadcaster in the Soviet scientific town of Troitsk who reinterprets music received from other worlds.
quotes: I'm not very good at speaking in front of a crowd… But over the radio, perhaps I can.
signatureLines: Comrades, see you tomorrow, see you next week.
sovia.biography: An interdimensional broadcaster in the science city who arranges music received from other worlds.
sovia.identity: Interdimensional broadcaster in the science city
sovia.worldOrigin: The world of the interdimensional radio station

relationships.description: Kata is like an older sister to Sovia and is also a leader at the Academy of Sciences.
Sovia and the in-universe Runa seem able to sense each other.

kata.name: Kata
kata.description: Fictional broadcast affairs inspector assigned to investigate anomalies after an interdimensional resonance transmission.
quotes: Sovia, your explanation is interesting. But what I need is a report.
kata.biography: An inspector assigned to investigate broadcast anomalies after an interdimensional resonance transmission.
kata.identity: Broadcast affairs inspector in the science city
kata.worldOrigin: The world of the interdimensional radio station

relationships.description: Kata treats Sovia like a little sister and cared for her when Sovia first arrived in the science city.

runa.name: Mikatsuki Runa
runa.description: The in-universe Runa helps Sovia carry her voice into the audience's world. This profile describes her role in the story, not the real-world creator's biography.
runa.identityNote: The real-world creator and in-universe Runa use the same stage name. Their profile IDs separate real-world biography from story facts. The +i marker classifies world of origin only; it does not establish whether this role is an avatar, self-insert, or separate fictional person.
quotes: So… which world do I belong to now?
runa.biography: Ordinary classes, part-time work, meals, sleep, and a little singing. She also helps Sovia carry her voice into your world.
runa.worldOrigin: Apparently the dimension where YouTube exists

relationships.description: The in-universe Runa and Sovia seem able to sense each other.
